items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: Well, there was Bud Russel, Baby Brewster, and this boy Frog and myself, it was four of us... we played practically all over the city on Sunday nights

ctx.x: Well, every Sunday they used to have yard parties. Mm-hmm. And they used to hire him and I because we was best at a lot at that time. Well, he had several other little outfits and then we had a boy from down on Parker, down on Parker Street that we called Frog. Well, he was very fat, he was much stoutier than Dick is.
